lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); S = require('lib.state'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); VIEW = function(who, yaw, d, h) local c = nova.named(who); local a = c.face + math.rad(yaw); local g = nova.terrain_height(c.x, c.z) + (c.y or 0); CAM.pinned = { c.x + math.sin(a) * d, g + h + 0.15, c.z + math.cos(a) * d, c.x, g + h, c.z, 34 } end; MEET = function(who, d) local r = nova.named(who); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); S.carrying = who; p.x, p.z = r.x + math.sin(r.face) * d, r.z + math.cos(r.face) * d; p.face = r.face + math.pi; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(p.face) end; STILL = function(who) local c = nova.named(who); c.mood.wait, c.mood.blink = 99, 0 end
